sources.statementForm: Margin editorial account, not verbatim citizen speech
sources.text: Alienate’s first proposal about the community’s decision rules failed to gather enough voters. Citizens are now challenging its second: why should five participants be enough to decide for the community? In its morning report on 5 September, Alienate says the new proposal still has no ballots.

editorial.selection: Published daily developments; scene list selected by Margin. No new board collection.
editorial.reason: Separate bands interrupted by a fixed gap; a composition about the unresolved decision, not a vote tally.
